position_overview: About the Role Were looking for a dependable, hardworking person who enjoys working with people and takes pride in doing a good job. Youll support the day-to-day operations of our business by serving customers, handling and delivering compressed gas cylinders, assembling hydraulic hoses, and helping wherever needed. No two days are the same. This is a practical, hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving problems, taking responsibility, and being part of a small, close-knit team. Join a growing business where youll learn new skills, take on real responsibility, and help us raise the standard. Who We Are BBG etc. builds on the legacy of Bermuda Bulk Gases and Tools & Equipment Unlimited. We supply industrial and medical gases, hydraulic hoses, and industrial consumables to Bermuda. Under new management, were investing in our people, systems, customer service, and safety culture. Our goal is to raise the standard. Who Were Looking For Were looking for someone who: Takes initiative, communicates well, and acts with integrity. Delivers excellent customer service and enjoys working with people. Wants to learn, grow, and take on more responsibility. Works safely and is physically capable of lifting and handling heavy materials. Is comfortable learning and using technology, including business software, mobile applications, and AI tools. Holds a valid Bermuda Heavy Truck Drivers Licence and has hydraulic hose assembly experience. Sales or business development experience would be an advantage. What Youll Do Deliver excellent customer service at the sales counter, by telephone, and during deliveries. Handle, inspect, and deliver compressed gas cylinders safely and professionally. Assemble, repair, inspect, and pressure test hydraulic hose assemblies. Support day-to-day operations. What We Offer Competitive compensation package. Performance-based bonus opportunities. On-the-job training and ongoing skills development. Opportunities for promotion and increased responsibility. A supportive team that values initiative and good ideas. How to Apply Please email your CV (rsum) and/or LinkedIn profile, together with a short note explaining your interest in the role to hr@bbgetc.com .
